name: browser-use
headline: Transform vague prompts with Claude Architect
short_description: Claude Code skill that transforms vague prompts into structured, expert-level prompts using 7 research-backed   frameworks (CO-STAR, RISEN, RISE, TIDD-EC, RTF, CoT, CoD)
author: ckelsoe

sections.overview:
Prompt Architect elevates your AI agent interactions by systematically transforming incomplete prompts into expert-level, structured prompts. The skill analyzes prompts across five quality dimensions (clarity, specificity, context, completeness, structure), recommends the best framework from 27 research-backed options across 7 intent categories, and guides you through targeted clarifying questions. It works seamlessly with Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and 30+ compatible AI tools, making it essential for developers, prompt engineers, and teams seeking consistent, high-quality prompt engineering.
Refining vague coding requests into detailed, structured prompts for AI agents
Optimizing content creation prompts with CO-STAR framework for business blogs
Structuring multi-step process prompts with RISEN framework
Improving data analysis prompts using RISE-IE for consistent outputs
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ckelsoe/claude-skill-prompt-architect`
sections.usage:
```
Transform this vague prompt into a structured, expert-level prompt using one of the 7 frameworks (CO-STAR, RISEN, RISE, TIDD-EC, RTF, CoT, CoD): '[VAGUE_PROMPT]'. The prompt should be specific to [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector, using [DATA] as a reference. Ensure the output is actionable and optimized for AI tools.
```
Copy

```
# Structured Prompt Using CO-STAR Framework

**Context**: [COMPANY] is a mid-sized tech firm in the [INDUSTRY] sector looking to optimize its customer support workflow.

**Objective**: Improve response times and customer satisfaction scores by 20% within the next quarter.

**Specify**: Utilize the existing [DATA] on customer interactions and support ticket trends.

**Task**: Develop a step-by-step plan to implement a new AI-driven support system that integrates with current CRM tools.

**Audience**: The plan should be tailored for the IT and customer support teams, with clear roles and responsibilities.

**Requirements**: The solution must comply with GDPR regulations and be scalable for future growth.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
